'''Lem-Ofars''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing in [[Toxic Lake Garrison]] on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he managed a vendor stand and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].
